name: Motown snare-and-tambourine pocket
desc: Funk Brothers pocket: RhythmAce kick anchoring 1 and 3, fat snare with tambourine glued on 2&4, 8th-note tambourine ride and soft 16th hat ghosts. Snare doubles into 8ths at peak the way Benny Benjamin leaned into a chorus.

gain.doc: kick level, other layers scale from it

code.full: stack(s("bd ~ bd [~ bd]").bank("RhythmAce").gain(${gain}).shape(.22), s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RhythmAce").gain(${gain}*.62).room(.32), s("tb*8").gain("[${tamb} .18]*4").hpf(1400).pan(cosine.range(.52,.66).slow(10)), s("hh*16").bank("RhythmAce").gain("[.24 .1 .16 .1]*4").pan(.4), s("~ ~ ~ [~ sd]").bank("RhythmAce").gain(.2).pan(.45).mask("<0 1 0 1>")).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("bd ~ bd [bd bd]").bank("RhythmAce").gain(${gain}).shape(.26), s("~ [sd sd] ~ [sd sd]").bank("RhythmAce").gain(${gain}*.6).room(.32), s("tb*8").gain("[${tamb} .22]*4").hpf(1300).pan(cosine.range(.5,.7).slow(8)), s("hh*16").bank("RhythmAce").gain("[.28 .12 .2 .12]*4").pan(.4).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("cr ~ ~ ~").bank("RhythmAce").gain(.26).mask("<1 0 0 0>")).orbit(1).play()
